title: Custom Components Guide does not seem to lead to a working example
body:
### Describe the bug

I tried following the guide at https://www.gradio.app/guides/custom-components-in-five-minutes.

I didn't make any code-changes yet, so I'm expecting to see my new component as a SimpleTextbox.

However when I go to the frontend URL I only see a screen with an infinite "Loading" text. The console shows these errors:

```
Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected token '{' (at (index):55:35)

svelte.js:3232 Uncaught (in promise) TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '$$')
    at init (svelte.js:3232:44)
    at new Blocks (Blocks.svelte:669:31)
    at Array.create_if_block_1 (index.svelte:184:43)
    at Object.p (Index.svelte:394:41)
    at update_slot_base (svelte.js:203:8)
    at Object.p (core.js:231:1)
    at update (svelte.js:2128:30)
    at flush (svelte.js:2088:5)
```

Line 55 at index looks like this:

`		<script>window.gradio_config = {{ config | toorjson }};</script>`

Is this a bug? Am I missing a step?

### Have you searched existing issues?  🔎

- [X] I have searched and found no existing issues

### Reproduction

Follow the guide until you enter the frontend URL.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
Hi all, we just released gradio version 4.21.0. If you're still having issues getting dev mode to work can you please upgrade to version `4.21.0` and pass the `--python-path` and `--gradio-path` arguments to `gradio cc dev`.

Something like

```python
gradio cc dev --python-path <path-to-your-python-executable> --gradio-path <path-to-your-gradio-executable
```

I suspect this issue stems from the custom component dev command picking up the wrong version of python installed in your system. We also added some debug output to `gradio cc dev`  that should help us further if that is not the cause of this issue.


PS: if you have a virtual environment, the path of the python executable is `<path-to-virtual-env>/bin/python`

comments.author: participant9
comments.body:
@participant1 I'm staying pretty close to the boilerplate for a custom component:

1. I created a custom component using the SimpleDropdown template
2. Ran `gradio cc dev` in the component root
3. Replaced the `app.py` code with `gr.Blocks()` code, nesting the custom component within it. A little like:

```python
with gr.Blocks() as demo:
    c = CustomComponent() # as input
    display_json = gr.JSON()
    c.change(lambda x: x, inputs=[c], outputs=[display_json])

demo.launch()
```

I take back `Components are not updating as expected`; I was missing a function call, i.e. `$: value, handle_change()` rather than `$: value, handle_change`, so that was an error with Svelte; components are updating now.

However, I am still seeing the error message in the console; it's just not impacting anything as far as I can tell.

to solve as workaround you need to change this line at file index.js in path ..\frontend\node_modules\@participant12\preview\dist\index.js

```
const m = await import(join(component.frontend_dir, "participant12.config.js"));
add "file://" to component.frontend_dir
const m = await import(join("file://"+component.frontend_dir, "participant12.config.js"));
```
